The process

From request to booking, in four steps

STEP 01

Submit

You complete the travel request and list your line manager's email address.

STEP 02

Quote

The RT team prepares your quotation and returns it to your line manager for approval, with you copied.

STEP 03

Approve

Your manager approves, declines, or escalates by email.

STEP 04

Book

RTM confirms flights, hotels and transfers, and sends details.
